fields.name: sequence
fields.documentation: The position this interval held in the v1 `valid_interval` ARRAY, 1-based, in append order (markgarbage.m:89, `vi(end+1) = validintervalstruct`). HAZARD 2, and the reason this field exists at all: one v1 document holds N intervals and decomposing it into N statements destroys their order unless it is carried explicitly. Order is load-bearing for ANALYSIS, not only for bookkeeping -- +app/+stimulus/tuning_response.m:253-256 loads the intervals and reads only `interval(1,1)`..`interval(1,2)`, the FIRST one, so a re-run against a reordered set would analyse a different stretch of signal and report different tuning. Same word and same meaning as `directed_relation.sequence` (T11: one canonical spelling per concept). Scoped to ONE source document: it orders the intervals that arrived together, and says nothing across elements. Empty when the statement did not come from a v1 array.
